localization.TOURS.HeroSheetBasicsDescription: Learn how to edit a Hero and make a roll.
localization.TOURS.HeroSheetBasicsWelcomeContent: This tour opens a sample Hero and explains the main sheet controls.
localization.TOURS.HeroSheetBasicsEditModeContent:
Use this button to switch between Play and Edit. Edit Mode lets you change themes, tags, and Hero details.

Keyboard shortcut: E
localization.TOURS.HeroSheetBasicsRollContent:
Click tags to add them to the roll, then click this button to open the roll window.

Keyboard shortcut: R
localization.TOURS.HeroSheetBasicsPromiseContent: The Promise track records progress toward a Moment of Fulfillment. Click a box to mark Promise. At 5 Promise, record a Moment of Fulfillment.
localization.TOURS.HeroSheetBasicsThemeTagsContent:
Each theme has power tags and weakness tags. Click a power tag to add it to a roll. The Narrator or an opponent can invoke a weakness tag.

A theme also has a Quest and advancement tracks. Mark their boxes during play.
localization.TOURS.HeroSheetBasicsLayoutContent: Open the menu and select Sheet Configuration to choose the narrow Portrait layout or wide Landscape layout.
localization.TOURS.HeroSheetBasicsSummaryContent:
E = toggle Edit Mode
R = open the dice roller

In Play Mode, click tags to add them to a roll. Use Edit Mode to change themes, tags, and Hero details.
